name: bpk
description: Banana Pudding Krazy website: React frontend (client/) and product API (server/)

scripts.dev: concurrently --names client,server --prefix-colors magenta,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && cd client && npx tsc -b
